native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1, 'state': {'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees', 'rgb1': 'off (0,0,0)'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, both servos are at 0 degrees and the RGB LED is off.'}

test2: {'time': 3, 'state': {'servo1': '90 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees', 'rgb1': 'red (1,0,0)'}, 'description': 'After pressing button1, servo1 rotates to 90 degrees and the RGB LED turns red. The state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}

test3: {'time': 5, 'state': {'servo1': '90 degrees', 'servo2': '90 degrees', 'rgb1': 'green (0,1,0)'}, 'description': 'After pressing button2, servo2 rotates to 90 degrees and the RGB LED turns green. The state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}

test4: {'time': 7, 'state': {'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees', 'rgb1': 'blue (0,0,1)'}, 'description': 'After pressing button3, both servos reset to 0 degrees and the RGB LED turns blue. The state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
